# run_length

run_length(s) returns the run-length encoding of s: each maximal run of one character becomes the run length in decimal followed by the character. run_length("") == "".

Examples:

- `run_length('zzzz') == '4z'`
- `run_length('xxxxbbbb') == '4x4b'`
